title: Context menu item for the schematic component under the cursor
summary: Adds a schematic right-click menu item whose GetState shows it only over a component, and reports the designator of the component found with PopupMenuHitTest.
phrasings: add an item to the schematic right-click menu
show a menu item only when right-clicking a component
get the component under the right-click
control menu item visibility with a GetState procedure

commands.name: ComponentUnderContextMenu
commands.description: Report the designator of the first component in the right-click hit list, with the hit-object and context-menu component counts
